name: bhutan-settlements
notes:
These spatial datasets of settlements are national datasets of populated places across Bhutan.

The Global Discovery data includes the location name in English and associated dzonghag and gewog name and code. This can be complemented by the OSM dataset that includes additional settlements with location name in English, place type and the associated dzonghag and gewog name and code.
